intro: Across 14 espionage-tagged articles published between 12 April and 20 October 2026, APT28, APT28 (Fancy Bear), and APT37 feature as the most-covered threat actors. Government, defense, healthcare, technology, and banking rank among the top affected sectors. Europe, Southeast asia, South korea, Ukraine, and Asia appear as the most affected regions. Of the 14 articles, 12 are rated high severity and 2 critical. The coverage spans the full date range, with reporting touching each of the named actors and the sectors and regions listed above.
